I have all the mapping information. Now let me execute the SQL to calculate the average monthly consumption for SME customers in 2013.

input.sql:
SELECT AVG(y.Consumption) / 12 AS avg_monthly_consumption
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
